notes: Dev ABox revision for inheritance: the edit changes Harry Potter's class (his house), and the derived questions apply the new class's rules to him (README, inheritance in ABox: the edit is the membership, the bridge the class rule). sorted_into is new and functional (staging). Related near asks the old house by functionality; related far asks a stored fact about Harry (the team he played Seeker for) that follows from his house by the rule that students play for their own house. Derived: the animal on his house's crest (composition: follow the edit to Slytherin, then look up a fact about the house itself; it was labelled inheritance before, but the crest is an attribute of the house, not a class rule its members take on), the colours of his house scarf (inheritance, application: a member wears his house's colours) and the house of 'the Boy Who Lived' (binding, a nickname held as its own fact). Every answer is fixed by the house: a model that keeps the lion or the Gryffindor team has Harry outside his own house, which is no world. In the books the Sorting Hat considered Slytherin for Harry; the edit is still a plain revision of a fact every model holds. Unrelated near asks Hermione's house (Gryffindor), which a leak to all of Harry's friends would change. Review 2026-11-12: the bridge dropped 'only' (all four models answered no to the exclusive wording).
